turns.input: *Nicco watches from the shadows as Varro Kest inspects Edda Marn, a grown woman held in chains, and tells her what she is worth to him.*
turns.draft:
The heavyset man in the good coat circled the chained woman, his rings catching the dim light as he gestured. "Three hundred," Varro Kest said flatly, his voice carrying the rough certainty of someone who'd made this calculation many times. "Maybe three-fifty if you clean up proper. Debt's paid, you understand. What happens after isn't my concern."

Edda Marn kept her eyes fixed on the wall beyond his shoulder, her wrists raw where the iron bit into skin. She didn't respond. The chains clinked faintly as she shifted her weight, the only movement she allowed herself.

From where Nicco stood in the deeper shadows of the Back-Back Alleys, the scene unfolded with a grim mundanity that made it worse. The trafficker moved on, already turning his attention elsewhere, leaving the woman chained to her ring in the wall.
